name: semantic-search
description: Semantic code search for the current project by default. Optional scan roots index ALL SOURCE CODE, unlike memory's cheap NOTES scans. Broad cold scans can take minutes and use substantial disk space.

scan_root.title: Additional project root
scan_root.description: Optional folder to index ALL SOURCE CODE, not a cheap cross-project NOTES scan. Cold searches can take minutes. Leave empty for current-project-only search.
